subject: Post-demo follow-up — prompt/output PII, retention, and residency for PatientFirst
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@patientfirst.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — prompt/output PII, retention, and residency for PatientFirst

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and three concrete asks so we can move the security review forward.

Recap (from our notes):
- PatientFirst will send free-text clinical notes and structured fields (name, DOB, MRN) as part of the assistant prompt/enrichment.
- Primary regulatory concern: HIPAA; PatientFirst requires evidence of SOC 2 and a BAA.
- Residency ask: logs and any persisted outputs must be stored in us-east-1 (single-region).

Questions / asks for you:
1) Confirm whether prompts ever include scanned images or attachments (we assume not for the POC).
2) Clarify the maximum retention you expect for prompts and generated outputs for auditing (30/90/180 days?).
3) Who on your side will own the security questionnaire? (security@patientfirst.com OK?)

What we can commit now (high-level):
- We can run the POC on Hosted with logging disabled, or on Dedicated/Private to meet single-region + BAA requirements.
- Hosted default is short-lived telemetry; we can scope a logging TTL and region locks for Dedicated.
- I’ve attached a compact matrix (redwood-data-handling-matrix.pdf) that maps what’s persisted by default and where.

Next steps proposed:
- Please confirm answers to Q1–Q3 above by EOD Thu so we can route to SRE/security.
- If you need >= 90 day retention, we should schedule a security review (Monica + our security engineer).
- We’ll prepare a scoped config for the demo environment and a draft BAA/tech annex for review.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-data-handling-matrix.pdf

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@patientfirst.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: security@patientfirst.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — prompt/output PII, retention, and residency for PatientFirst

Thanks Dev — good summary. Quick answers inline: 

On Tue, Apr 11, 2028 at 2:05 PM Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier...

1) Prompts: will include patient names, MRNs, DOBs, and short clinical notes. No scanned images in the POC (we will not send PDFs).
2) Retention: for audit/compliance we need access to prompts/outputs for 180 days. After that data should be deletable. For logs (server-side access logs), 90 days is acceptable, but audit copies of outputs tied to incidents should be preservable up to 2 years on request.
3) Security point: security@patientfirst.com will own the questionnaire and can accept your matrix. I’m looping them in.

Additional constraints: we require KMS-backed encryption with our key, and region-lock to us-east-1 for any persisted data. HIPAA/BAA is a blocker for production — we’ll need a BAA before we move beyond POC.

Next step from our side: security@patientfirst.com will send the first pass of the questionnaire and a list of mandatory controls. Can you confirm you can provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and a draft BAA?

—Alex Turner
CTO, PatientFirst Health
alex.turner@patientfirst.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@patientfirst.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — prompt/output PII, retention, and residency for PatientFirst

Alex — thanks for the clear answers. Attaching a short config guide and a proposed mapping for the retention requests (redwood-pii-config-guide.pdf). Key technical confirmations below.

On Tue, Apr 11, 2028 at 4:18 PM Alex Turner <alex.turner@patientfirst.com> wrote:
> Retention: for audit/compliance we need access to prompts/outputs for 180 days...

What Redwood can do (defaults vs. configurable):
- Hosted (quick POC): by default, session inputs and generated outputs are not persisted long-term in plaintext — telemetry is kept for 30 days for diagnostics. We offer a "no-logging" flag to prevent storing prompt/output content at all in Hosted.
- Dedicated / Private deployment: supports region-locking (us-east-1), and can be configured to use your customer-managed KMS key (bring-your-own-key) for all persisted artifacts (models’ KV cache, logs, and any optional output archives).
- Retention controls: configurable TTL per tenant. We can set output/prompt TTL to 180 days for the POC environment, and set server audit/log retention to 90 days. If you need longer legal hold (e.g., 2 years for incident artifacts), we support manual snapshot/export on request and an archival workflow (protected by your KMS key).
- Redaction / tokenization: we can offer client-side redaction patterns or a pre-ingest transform that strips selected PII fields prior to sending to Redwood if you prefer never to persist names/MRNs.

Action items I’m proposing (with owners):
- Dev: share the POC sample dataset schema and a small sample (redacted) — due Thu 2028-04-14.
- Alex/Security: send questionnaire to security@redwood.com — due Fri 2028-04-15.
- Monica: schedule 45-min technical & SRE call to validate region-lock and KMS integration — propose Mon 2028-04-18 10am ET.
- Ben: will scope BAA + commercial language with legal — Ben will share a draft within 5 business days.

Attachments: redwood-pii-config-guide.pdf, patientfirst-soc2-questions.xlsx

Let me know if the proposed retention numbers (180d outputs / 90d logs) match your compliance baseline. We’ll include the alternate path (no-hosted-logging + dedicated deployment) in the tech annex for your legal review.

—Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (212) 555-0183
